title: Object
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw the first loop starting with the first line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0), followed by the second line from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.025). Continue with the third line from (0.75, 0.025) to (0.35, 0.025), the fourth line from (0.35, 0.025) to (0.35, 0.03), and the fifth line from (0.35, 0.03) to (0.75, 0.03). Draw the sixth line from (0.75, 0.03) to (0.75, 0.055), the seventh line from (0.75, 0.055) to (0.35, 0.055), and the eighth line from (0.35, 0.055) to (0.35, 0.06). Add the ninth line from (0.35, 0.06) to (0.75, 0.06), the tenth line from (0.75, 0.06) to (0.75, 0.085), and the eleventh line from (0.75, 0.085) to (0.0, 0.085). Finally, draw the twelfth line from (0.0, 0.085) back to the origin. Scale the entire two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.75. Transform the scaled sketch into three dimensions by rotating it using the same Euler angles and translating it using the same translation vector. Extrude the sketch 0.015 units along the normal direction to create a solid body. The resulting object is a rectangular prism with a cylindrical base, measuring 0.75 units in length, 0.085 units in width, and 0.015 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.025) \
     .lineTo(0.35, 0.025) \
     .lineTo(0.35, 0.03) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.03) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.055) \
     .lineTo(0.35, 0.055) \
     .lineTo(0.35, 0.06) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.06) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.085) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.085) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.015)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Overall dimensions
L = 0.7500   # X
W = 0.0850   # Y
T = 0.0150   # Z

# Base plate
base = cq.Workplane("XY").box(L, W, T, centered=(False, False, False))

# Two thin slots cut from the right end, running through in X to the end
slot_w = 0.0065
slot_len = L - 0.35
y1 = 0.0311 - slot_w / 2.0
y2 = 0.0622 - slot_w / 2.0

slot1 = cq.Workplane("XY").transformed(offset=(0.35, y1, -0.001)) \
    .box(slot_len, slot_w, T + 0.002, centered=(False, False, False))
slot2 = cq.Workplane("XY").transformed(offset=(0.35, y2, -0.001)) \
    .box(slot_len, slot_w, T + 0.002, centered=(False, False, False))

r = base.cut(slot1).cut(slot2)

lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Base flat bar: 0.75 (X) x 0.085 (Y) x 0.015 (Z)
base = cq.Workplane("XY").box(0.75, 0.085, 0.015, centered=(False, False, False))

# Slot cut in from the right end, centered in Y, through the full thickness
slot_width = 0.01
slot = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(0.41, slot_width, 0.02, centered=(False, False, False))
    .translate((0.35, (0.085 - slot_width) / 2.0, -0.0025))
)

r = base.cut(slot)
